text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are men, making sex discrimination between you extremely improbable. An all-male panel may reflect institutional diversity issues, but it provides no evidence that sex influenced this decision. Raising gender bias when one man was chosen over another will appear baseless and damage your professional credibility.

Instead, pursue procedural and qualification grounds. You have a master's in educational leadership and five years as deputy principal, while the appointee has only coursework and classroom experience. Follow up firmly on your outstanding request for a written explanation, focusing on objective selection criteria, scoring matrices, and merit.
